question: For each player, list their ID, name, their most frequent role across all matches, batting hand, bowling skill, total runs scored, total matches played, total times they were dismissed, batting average (total runs divided by total dismissals), highest score in a single match, the number of matches in which they scored at least 30 runs, at least 50 runs, and at least 100 runs, total balls faced in their career, strike rate (total runs divided by total balls faced, multiplied by 100), total wickets taken, economy rate (average runs conceded per over), and their best bowling performance in a single match (most wickets taken in a match, formatted as "wickets taken-runs given", where the best performance is the one with the most wickets, and if tied, the fewest runs conceded). Ignore the extra runs data.

prediction.sql:
WITH
bat AS (
  SELECT b.striker AS pid, b.match_id, SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored,0)) AS runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored s
    ON b.match_id=s.match_id AND b.over_id=s.over_id AND b.ball_id=s.ball_id AND b.innings_no=s.innings_no
  WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
bat_agg AS (
  SELECT pid,
    SUM(runs) AS total_runs,
    MAX(runs) AS highest,
    SUM(CASE WHEN runs>=30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m30,
    SUM(CASE WHEN runs>=50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m50,
    SUM(CASE WHEN runs>=100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m100
  FROM bat GROUP BY pid
),
balls AS (
  SELECT b.striker AS pid, COUNT(*) AS balls
  FROM ball_by_ball b WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.striker
),
dismiss AS (
  SELECT w.player_out AS pid, COUNT(*) AS dism
  FROM wicket_taken w GROUP BY w.player_out
),
bowl AS (
  SELECT b.bowler AS pid, b.match_id,
    COUNT(w.player_out) AS wkts,
    SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored,0)) AS runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w
    ON b.match_id=w.match_id AND b.over_id=w.over_id AND b.ball_id=w.ball_id AND b.innings_no=w.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored s
    ON b.match_id=s.match_id AND b.over_id=s.over_id AND b.ball_id=s.ball_id AND b.innings_no=s.innings_no
  WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
bowl_agg AS (
  SELECT pid,
    SUM(wkts) AS total_wkts,
    SUM(runs) AS total_runs_conceded,
    COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
  FROM bowl GROUP BY pid
),
best_bowl AS (
  SELECT pid, wkts || '-' || runs AS perf,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY wkts DESC, runs ASC) AS rn
  FROM bowl
),
role AS (
  SELECT player_id AS pid, role,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, role ASC) AS rn
  FROM player_match GROUP BY player_id, role
),
pm AS (
  SELECT player_id AS pid, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches_played
  FROM player_match GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT
  p.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  r.role,
  p.batting_hand,
  p.bowling_skill,
  COALESCE(ba.total_runs,0) AS total_runs,
  COALESCE(pm.matches_played,0) AS matches_played,
  COALESCE(d.dism,0) AS dismissals,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.dism,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE ba.total_runs*1.0/d.dism END AS batting_avg,
  ba.highest,
  COALESCE(ba.m30,0) AS m30,
  COALESCE(ba.m50,0) AS m50,
  COALESCE(ba.m100,0) AS m100,
  COALESCE(bl.balls,0) AS balls_faced,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(bl.balls,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE ba.total_runs*100.0/bl.balls END AS strike_rate,
  COALESCE(bb.total_wkts,0) AS total_wkts,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(bb.balls_bowled,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE bb.total_runs_conceded*6.0/bb.balls_bowled END AS economy,
  bbp.perf AS best_bowl
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN role r ON r.pid=p.player_id AND r.rn=1
LEFT JOIN pm ON pm.pid=p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bat_agg ba ON ba.pid=p.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls bl ON bl.pid=p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismiss d ON d.pid=p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowl_agg bb ON bb.pid=p.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowl bbp ON bbp.pid=p.player_id AND bbp.rn=1
ORDER BY p.player_id

initial_search.query:
For each player, list their ID, name, their most frequent role across all matches, batting hand, bowling skill, total runs scored, total matches played, total times they were dismissed, batting average (total runs divided by total dismissals), highest score in a single match, the number of matches in which they scored at least 30 runs, at least 50 runs, and at least 100 runs, total balls faced in their career, strike rate (total runs divided by total balls faced, multiplied by 100), total wickets taken, economy rate (average runs conceded per over), and their best bowling performance in a single match (most wickets taken in a match, formatted as "wickets taken-runs given", where the best performance is the one with the most wickets, and if tied, the fewest runs conceded). Ignore the extra runs data.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: # Special Words Definition

## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.
- Batting Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Dismissals

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.
- Strike Rate = (Total Runs ÷ Balls Faced) × 100

## Wickets Taken
- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

## Economy Rate
- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.
- Economy Rate = (Total Runs Conceded ÷ Balls Bowled) × 6

## Wickets Taken
- The number of times a bowler successfully dismisses a batsman in a single match.  This metric is a direct indicator of the bowler's effectiveness, showing how many players they were able to remove from play.

## Runs Given
- The total number of runs scored by the batting side off a particular bowler’s deliveries in a single match.  This value reflects the runs the bowler has conceded to the batting team, and a lower runs-given value is typically favorable for the bowler's performance.

WITH

  SELECT b.striker AS pid, b.match_id, SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored,0)) AS runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b

    ON b.match_id=s.match_id AND b.over_id=s.over_id AND b.ball_id=s.ball_id AND b.innings_no=s.innings_no
  WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
bat_agg AS (
  SELECT pid,
    SUM(runs) AS total_runs,
    MAX(runs) AS highest,
    SUM(CASE WHEN runs>=30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m30,
    SUM(CASE WHEN runs>=50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m50,
    SUM(CASE WHEN runs>=100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m100
  FROM bat GROUP BY pid
),
balls AS (
  SELECT b.striker AS pid, COUNT(*) AS balls
  FROM ball_by_ball b WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.striker
),
dismiss AS (
  SELECT w.player_out AS pid, COUNT(*) AS dism
  FROM wicket_taken w GROUP BY w.player_out
),
bowl AS (
  SELECT b.bowler AS pid, b.match_id,
    COUNT(w.player_out) AS wkts,
    SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored,0)) AS runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w
    ON b.match_id=w.match_id AND b.over_id=w.over_id AND b.ball_id=w.ball_id AND b.innings_no=w.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored s
    ON b.match_id=s.match_id AND b.over_id=s.over_id AND b.ball_id=s.ball_id AND b.innings_no=s.innings_no
  WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
bowl_agg AS (
  SELECT pid,
    SUM(wkts) AS total_wkts,
    SUM(runs) AS total_runs_conceded,
    COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
  FROM bowl GROUP BY pid
),
best_bowl AS (
  SELECT pid, wkts || '-' || runs AS perf,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY wkts DESC, runs ASC) AS rn
  FROM bowl
),
role AS (
  SELECT player_id AS pid, role,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, role ASC) AS rn
  FROM player_match GROUP BY player_id, role
),
pm AS (
  SELECT player_id AS pid, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches_played
  FROM player_match GROUP BY player_id
)

  p.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  r.role,
  p.batting_hand,
  p.bowling_skill,
  COALESCE(ba.total_runs,0) AS total_runs,
  COALESCE(pm.matches_played,0) AS matches_played,
  COALESCE(d.dism,0) AS dismissals,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.dism,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE ba.total_runs*1.0/d.dism END AS batting_avg,

  COALESCE(bl.balls,0) AS balls_faced,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(bl.balls,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE ba.total_runs*100.0/bl.balls END AS strike_rate,
  COALESCE(bb.total_wkts,0) AS total_wkts,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(bb.balls_bowled,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE bb.total_runs_conceded*6.0/bb.balls_bowled END AS economy,
  bbp.perf AS best_bowl
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN role r ON r.pid=p.player_id AND r.rn=1
LEFT JOIN pm ON pm.pid=p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bat_agg ba ON ba.pid=p.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls bl ON bl.pid=p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismiss d ON d.pid=p.player_id

ORDER BY p.player_id

WITH
batting AS (
  SELECT bbb.striker AS player_id,
         SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored,0)) AS total_runs,
         COUNT(DISTINCT bbb.match_id) AS total_matches,
         MAX(m.runs) AS highest_score,
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.runs>=30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m30,
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.runs>=50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m50,
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.runs>=100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m100,
         COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
  FROM ball_by_ball bbb
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id=bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id=bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id=bs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no=bs.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT bbb2.striker AS player_id, bbb2.match_id, SUM(COALESCE(bs2.runs_scored,0)) AS runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb2
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs2 ON bbb2.match_id=bs2.match_id AND bbb2.over_id=bs2.over_id AND bbb2.ball_id=bs2.ball_id AND bbb2.innings_no=bs2.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb2.striker, bbb2.match_id
  ) m ON bbb.striker=m.player_id AND bbb.match_id=m.match_id
  GROUP BY bbb.striker
),
dismissals AS (
  SELECT wt.player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
  FROM wicket_taken wt
  GROUP BY wt.player_out
),
bowling AS (
  SELECT bbb.bowler AS player_id,
         COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
         SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored,0)) AS runs_conceded,
         COUNT(wt.player_out) AS total_wickets
  FROM ball_by_ball bbb
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id=bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id=bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id=bs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no=bs.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bbb.match_id=wt.match_id AND bbb.over_id=wt.over_id AND bbb.ball_id=wt.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no=wt.innings_no
  GROUP BY bbb.bowler
),
best_bowl AS (
  SELECT player_id,
         CAST(wickets AS TEXT) || '-' || CAST(runs AS TEXT) AS best_perf
  FROM (
    SELECT bbb.bowler AS player_id, bbb.match_id,
           COUNT(wt.player_out) AS wickets,
           SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored,0)) AS runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bbb.bowler ORDER BY COUNT(wt.player_out) DESC, SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored,0)) ASC) AS rn
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id=bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id=bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id=bs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no=bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bbb.match_id=wt.match_id AND bbb.over_id=wt.over_id AND bbb.ball_id=wt.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no=wt.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler, bbb.match_id
  )
  WHERE rn=1
),
role AS (
  SELECT player_id, role AS most_frequent_role
  FROM (
    SELECT player_id, role,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, role ASC) AS rn
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
  )
  WHERE rn=1
)
SELECT p.player_id,
       p.player_name,
       r.most_frequent_role,
       p.batting_hand,
       p.bowling_skill,
       COALESCE(bat.total_runs,0) AS total_runs,
       COALESCE(bat.total_matches,0) AS total_matches,
       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals,0) AS total_dismissals,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.total_dismissals,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(COALESCE(bat.total_runs,0) AS REAL)/d.total_dismissals END AS batting_average,
       COALESCE(bat.highest_score,0) AS highest_score,
       COALESCE(bat.m30,0) AS matches_30,
       COALESCE(bat.m50,0) AS matches_50,
       COALESCE(bat.m100,0) AS matches_100,
       COALESCE(bat.balls_faced,0) AS balls_faced,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(bat.balls_faced,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(COALESCE(bat.total_runs,0) AS REAL)/bat.balls_faced*100 END AS strike_rate,
       COALESCE(bow.total_wickets,0) AS total_wickets,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(bow.balls_bowled,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(COALESCE(bow.runs_conceded,0) AS REAL)/bow.balls_bowled*6 END AS economy_rate,
       bb.best_perf AS best_bowling
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN role r ON p.player_id=r.player_id
LEFT JOIN batting bat ON p.player_id=bat.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals d ON p.player_id=d.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling bow ON p.player_id=bow.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowl bb ON p.player_id=bb.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_id;

  SELECT w.player_out AS pid, COUNT(*) AS dism
  FROM wicket_taken w GROUP BY w.player_out
),
bowl AS (
  SELECT b.bowler AS pid, b.match_id,
    COUNT(w.player_out) AS wkts,
    SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored,0)) AS runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w
    ON b.match_id=w.match_id AND b.over_id=w.over_id AND b.ball_id=w.ball_id AND b.innings_no=w.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored s
    ON b.match_id=s.match_id AND b.over_id=s.over_id AND b.ball_id=s.ball_id AND b.innings_no=s.innings_no
  WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
bowl_agg AS (
  SELECT pid,
    SUM(wkts) AS total_wkts,
    SUM(runs) AS total_runs_conceded,
    COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
  FROM bowl GROUP BY pid
),
best_bowl AS (
  SELECT pid, wkts || '-' || runs AS perf,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY wkts DESC, runs ASC) AS rn
  FROM bowl
),
role AS (
  SELECT player_id AS pid, role,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, role ASC) AS rn
  FROM player_match GROUP BY player_id, role
),
pm AS (
  SELECT player_id AS pid, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches_played
  FROM player_match GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT
  p.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  r.role,
  p.batting_hand,
  p.bowling_skill,
  COALESCE(ba.total_runs,0) AS total_runs,
  COALESCE(pm.matches_played,0) AS matches_played,
  COALESCE(d.dism,0) AS dismissals,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.dism,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE ba.total_runs*1.0/d.dism END AS batting_avg,
  ba.highest,
  COALESCE(ba.m30,0) AS m30,
  COALESCE(ba.m50,0) AS m50,
  COALESCE(ba.m100,0) AS m100,
  COALESCE(bl.balls,0) AS balls_faced,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(bl.balls,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE ba.total_runs*100.0/bl.balls END AS strike_rate,
  COALESCE(bb.total_wkts,0) AS total_wkts,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(bb.balls_bowled,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE bb.total_runs_conceded*6.0/bb.balls_bowled END AS economy,
  bbp.perf AS best_bowl
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN role r ON r.pid=p.player_id AND r.rn=1
LEFT JOIN pm ON pm.pid=p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bat_agg ba ON ba.pid=p.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls bl ON bl.pid=p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismiss d ON d.pid=p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowl_agg bb ON bb.pid=p.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowl bbp ON bbp.pid=p.player_id AND bbp.rn=1
ORDER BY p.player_id
